endpoints.description: REQUIRED. A dictionary containing the endpoints for payment processing, contact updates, and order tracking. For the list of dictionary keys, see ApplePayEndpoints dictionary.

merchantSession.description: REQUIRED. A dictionary containing the payment session provided by Apple Pay after requesting a new payment session. For more information, see Requesting an Apple Pay Payment Session.

paymentRequest.description: REQUIRED. A dictionary with information about the payment request. For the list of dictionary keys, see ApplePayPaymentRequest dictionary.
